raw:
Ashara’s tail stills.

“I will. There are enough people here who mistake volunteering for usefulness.”

Rashid glances at the knife before returning to his plate. “The octagon has a viewing rail. Tomorrow’s bouts begin after second bell. Watch one before deciding you want lessons.”

“Sound advice,” Caelindra says. “Though perhaps less entertaining than allowing a novice to discover a guard by accident.”

Thessaly unwraps the rest of her sweet. “It would be brief entertainment.”

Caelindra looks back to you, interest settling on the story you had begun rather than the knife.

“What was the assignment the cheating student slipped into your pile?”
